source: Own native measurement for version 0.3 (moving tissue, tips in tissue and smoke, knocked camera head, takeovers, horizon 10 deg and fine-work 32 px/s, development material without 3D truth; generator endosim-procedure/0.4): tests/review/run_native.py (verify.grade and verify.score unchanged, the same hidden set, sessions, probes, budgets, renderer and canary; the controller and the renderer as the calling account), the privileged reference (solution/reference: privileged tips, scope, camera head angle of the frame and latency in place of perception and identification; rate commands through the public wire) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps, rigs by tests/review/draw_rigs.py, version 0.3's salts and camera head changes by tests/review/draw_v3.py): useful_view_fraction 0.8110417 on the tree of d31ae95b (state and judging identical to the final tree's: the later commits change the rendered plume, the labels, the count of lens touches the reference never makes, and text), per procedure 0.8438 0.8037 0.8888 0.6913 0.7675 0.8287 0.7262 0.8512 0.8612 0.9113 0.8213 0.7375, probe pairs 213 of 557 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no takeover, 45 critical actions all seen, no lens contact, no restart; the canary 10 of 10 markers within 0.75 px; 128.7 ms a frame. Host: the author's development server, an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada on driver 570.195.03 shared with other jobs, outside the engine. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer; over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop (tests/review/fast_eval.py's sessions) gave 0.81104 to 0.81167, with no takeover in any draw, every critical action seen usable on at least 0.727 of its steps (the rule ends a procedure under 0.25) and the lens never within 37.1 mm of the tissue (contact: 4 mm). full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Version 0.2's anchor was 0.876 (validate-7485b98b), version 0.1's 0.903. To be replaced by the oracle of version 0.3's first ale validate. Status: tests/README.md section 7.
